final_answer_raw:
The scene where backup dancers are struggling out of a silver cloth placed on the ground occurs around the **427.9s** mark. In this frame, we can see a large silver sheet covering the stage floor. Britney Spears is standing near the center/right of this sheet. To the left, there appear to be backup dancers emerging from under it. Specifically, there is one dancer in a purple outfit running/moving vigorously to the left, and another figure right next to/behind her also moving out. On the far right edge, there is one other dancer standing still or waiting. The ones "struggling out" (actively emerging) are the ones on the left. Looking closely at the cluster, there seem to be **2** distinct figures actively moving out from under the cloth in that specific moment captured by the frame.

(D)
